headline: Thanksgiving pause, five days to the lockout: King, Suzuki, Arozarena and Morejon are still unsigned, and the belief is King goes before the weekend is out.

news.title: Crow-Armstrong sets the pre-arb bonus pool record: $3.55 million
news.note: The NL MVP topped Skenes' 2025 mark; Misiorowski and Schlittler were next. MLB proposes growing the $50M pool to $65M; the union wants $180M.

news.title: Twins sign Kevin Ginkel; Nationals add A.J. Puk
news.note: Ginkel gets two years, $18M (Feinsand). Puk gets one year, $5M in Washington (Passan). The reliever tier is clearing out too.
Jeff Passan had it. Colorado's second multi-year starter of the night after Peterson, for a lefty who missed all of 2025 after elbow surgery.
news.title: Rockies sign Patrick Sandoval: three years, $42 million

news.note: Robert Murray had it first. Cleveland, the smallest payroll in baseball last spring, has now added Griffin and Kris Bubic in two days.
news.title: Guardians bring back Foster Griffin: three years, $48 million

news.note: Jeff Passan reported it, pending a physical. Gausman is the only pitcher with 30-plus starts every season since 2021.
news.title: Kevin Gausman to the Tigers: one year, $25 million

news.note: The league wants a federal judge to rule a lockout legal under antitrust law. The union called the suit 'completely frivolous.'
news.title: MLB sues the players' union to protect the coming lockout
